canonical_project: ST Digital DLA01 / Datacenter Services Douala
notes: ST Digital's DLA01 in Douala, Littoral is described as the first carrier-neutral and Tier 3-built facility in Central Africa and host of Douala-IX. PeeringDB lists it as Datacenter Services Douala / DLA01 at Rue 1033, Port de Douala, Bonanjo, with eight networks and one local exchange. No public MW capacity found.
